propositions: Build and validate a one-time Git history-strip operational script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) that removes .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, empty commits, and tree identity after dynamic re-add.
The script must refuse execution on partial/blob:none clones and require a fresh unfiltered clone, because fast-import fails with blob-not-found in partial clones.

Rewritten branch must have identical commit and merge-commit counts, identical tree hash after dynamic re-add, zero commits touching target prefixes except HEAD re-add, and resulting pack size ≤ 150 MB.
Script must preserve source remote branch and tag refs exactly unchanged, emit no push operations, and perform all graph/tree/history/pack assertions before emitting final success.
Dry-run must handle binary data-block framing by byte length rather than line filtering to safely preserve commit messages beginning with M or D command characters.
A synthetic representative review-bot event pushed after rewrite must show old tip is not an ancestor and incremental pack growth < 1 MB.
